criteria.text: Setup: the installed PR #130 HolyAgent user-scope setup runs successfully with every capability available on this Windows system enabled and configured.

result:
Setup and verification are complete. Report:

## Setup (installed PR #130 build, user scope)

Ran `holyagent.js setup --scope user --no-tui --worktrees on --device-access on --<all 13 capabilities> on` from the installation at `C:\Users\david.basile\.pi\agent\git\github.com\davidbasilefilho\holyagent`. Exit 0. Form detected: **normal** (graphical session). It installed the seven Pi packages at their pins (`pi-provider-kimi-code@0.6.13`, `pi-subagents@0.23.2`, `billion-context@0.1.213`, `rpiv-todo@2.15.0`, `rpiv-ask-user-question@2.15.0`, `pi-computer-use@0.1.38`, `pi-fff@0.11.0`), merged Claude user settings (attribution, opus model settings, holyagent marketplace/plugin, WebSearch/WebFetch deny), wrote T3 settings (worktrees on), and kept all pre-existing values.

## Kimi configuration

`~/.holyagent/config.json` now sets `pi.provider: "kimi-coding-global"` with root route `model: "kimi-for-coding"` (the installed schema's Kimi provider; its Pi provider id is `kimi-coding`). Setup merged Pi settings but kept the previously set `defaultProvider/defaultModel`, so per the task I set Pi's user settings to `defaultProvider: "kimi-coding"`, `defaultModel: "kimi-for-coding"` directly; `defaultThinkingLevel: "high"` came from setup. `pi auth check --provider kimi-coding --model kimi-for-coding` → `{"status":"ready","authType":"oauth"}`. No unrelated keys were touched (`theme: dark`, `holyclaude` marketplace, `npmCommand`, `codemode`, etc. all preserved; verified by diff against backups).

## Verification

`doctor --scope user` exit 0, including `ok root model: kimi-coding/kimi-for-coding:high`. `pi list` shows the HolyAgent git package plus 7 npm packages. Headless load test: `pi -p --no-session --provider kimi-coding --model kimi-for-coding` in a clean temp dir (all user extensions loaded) answered `OK`, exit 0.

## Capability-by-capability

- subagents, context-compression, todo, ask, mcp, just-bash, fff: **working** (packages installed/listed at pins; fff's native lib covers win32-x64).
- computer-use: **working** (normal form, display detected, package installed, confirm flags set).
- browser-use: **configured**; the browse MCP registration is in place, but pairing the browser extension is a manual GUI step — the scanner found it in no browser (Chrome/Edge/Brave/Vivaldi/Opera); run `npx -y @opencode/browse@0.0.16 install` in a desktop session.
- processes: **unsupported on Windows** — its package supports only darwin/linux (doctor: "nothing is expected of it").
- luna-reserve, context-management, auto-review: **not applicable under Kimi** — Codex-provider-only capabilities, absent by design.
- T3 device access: **unavailable on this machine** — no Xcode iOS simulator or Android SDK (explicitly left out by setup); worktrees enabled.

Logs and config backups: `C:\Users\david.basile\AppData\Local\Temp\holyagent-setup\` (`setup.log`, `doctor.log`, `pi-load.log`, `*.bak`).
